charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for late night (22:00+). On Day 26 at 17:26, it was at desk_o1. The "nightstand_b1" pattern is strictly for very late night (22:00+). For late afternoon (17:00-18:00), check desk_o1, as Tomas may still be at his desk or just leaving. Do not check nightstand_b1 before 22:00.

glass_tomas: Previous notes suggested cupboard_k1 for late night (22:00+). On Day 26 at 22:54, it was actually at nightstand_b1. The "cupboard_k1" pattern is incorrect for late night. Check nightstand_b1 for late night queries (22:00+). For mid-day (12:00-14:00), check kitchen_table_k1, as seen on Day 26 at 12:56. Do not check dining_table_d1 for mid-day.

mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested sink_k1 for mid-afternoon based on Day 26. On Day 27 at 15:34, it was actually at desk_o1. The "sink_k1" pattern is unreliable for mid-afternoon (15:00-17:00). Check desk_o1 for mid-afternoon, as Tomas is likely at his desk. For late night (22:00+), check cupboard_k1, as seen on Day 26 at 22:13. Do not check nightstand_b1 for late night.

water_bottle_tomas: No new evidence today contradicts previous notes. Continue checking desk_o1 for morning/afternoon (09:00-17:00) and dining_table_d1 for evening (18:00-21:00).

book_tomas: No new evidence today contradicts previous notes. Continue checking coffee_table_l1 for morning (08:00-12:00) and bed_b1 for late night (22:00+).
